summary.text: Mike Belcher is a Republican state representative from Carroll 4 who has served in the House since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Belcher is a writer and former EMT and paramedic.

paragraphs.text: Mike Belcher was born in Portsmouth, New Hampshire, graduated from Portsmouth High School and lives in Wakefield, New Hampshire.
His career experience includes working in heavy industry, as an EMT and paramedic with the Durham Ambulance Corps, and as a writer.
